statement: Let n = len(nums). A sign choice is a function epsilon from {0,...,n-1} to {1,-1}. For a sign choice, define t_epsilon(i) = nums[i] + epsilon(i)*k for 0 <= i < n, and define score(epsilon) = max_{0<=i<n} t_epsilon(i) - min_{0<=i<n} t_epsilon(i). Whenever the function returns a result r, r = min { score(epsilon) | epsilon is a sign choice }.
preconditions: The input satisfies the problem constraints: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10000; and 0 <= k <= 10000.

statement: Let n = len(nums) and let s be the nondecreasing sort of nums. For each j with 0 <= j <= n, let U_j = { s[i] + k | 0 <= i < j } ∪ { s[i] - k | j <= i < n }. Whenever the function returns a result r, r = min_{0 <= j <= n} (max U_j - min U_j), where the max and min are over the nonempty set U_j.
